How it works

From your ideal customer to the right properties.

01

Define your ideal customer

Choose your area and the property characteristics that matter to your business—such as roof size, existing solar panels or outdoor space.

02

Find matching properties

Our configurable satellite-image analysis identifies homes that appear to meet your criteria, property by property.

03

Human verification

Potential matches are checked against your brief before they're delivered, so your team starts with a more relevant prospect list.

04

Put your leads to work

Export your verified property list for your own campaign, or use LOCAYTER's optional direct-mail service to reach selected addresses.

About LOCAYTER

Property intelligence built for real-world sales.

Our mission is simple: help property-led businesses approach customer acquisition with more precision, less wasted effort and a clearer path from targeting to outreach.

We believe useful technology should do more than identify a potential opportunity. It should produce information your team can act on—whether you're prospecting around one postcode or building campaigns across multiple territories.
